insight_brake_early: Early braking. You braked {brake_delta}m earlier than the reference, resulting in a minimum corner speed {v_delta} km/h slower.
insight_overdriving: Overdriving entry. You braked late ({brake_delta}m after), missed the apex, and delayed throttle application by {throttle_delta}m.
insight_slow_apex: Excessively slow corner entry. You lost {v_delta} km/h at the apex compared to the optimal lap.
insight_late_throttle: Compromised exit. It took you {throttle_delta}m longer to get back to full throttle.
insight_general_loss: General sector loss of {delta}s. Review your line.
insight_excellent: Excellent execution! You gained {delta}s in this section.
insight_optimal: Optimal execution, very similar to the reference.
dyn_subviraje_critico: CRITICAL UNDERSTEER — {base} Front axle fully saturated. Reduce entry speed or soften the front anti-roll bar.
dyn_subviraje_media: Moderate understeer — {base} The driver is adding steering lock without getting rotation. Review entry line or setup balance.
dyn_subviraje_leve: Mild understeer — {base} Slightly elevated entry speed. The front axle loses grip marginally.
dyn_base_sobreviraje: Corner {curva} at {dist}m: {lat_g}G peak with steering correction.
dyn_sobreviraje_critico: CRITICAL OVERSTEER — {base} The rear axle steps out violently. Check rear tyre pressures, differential setting, or rear bar stiffness.
dyn_sobreviraje_media: Moderate oversteer — {base} Controllable rear grip loss. Evaluate differential adjustment or reduce corner entry.
dyn_sobreviraje_leve: Mild oversteer — {base} Slight tail movement, corrected without loss of control. Monitor in higher temperature conditions.
anomaly_desc_critico: Critical execution error between {start_m}m and {end_m}m. The model detects severe deviations in multiple channels simultaneously. Review line, braking point, and car dynamics.
anomaly_desc_media: Moderate anomaly between {start_m}m and {end_m}m. The combination of speed, pedals, and steering differs from the reference execution. Possible tyre overheating or line error.
anomaly_desc_leve: Mild deviation between {start_m}m and {end_m}m. The driving profile separates marginally from the optimal lap.
cluster_ataque_limpio: Clean Attack — Fast apex and early exit
cluster_entrada_agresiva: Aggressive Entry — Brakes late, compromises exit
cluster_erractico: Erratic Driving — Unstable steering at the apex
cluster_consistente: Consistent Execution — Faithful replication of the reference

setup_problem_camber_outer_hot: Tyre {pos}: outer face +{grad}°C hotter than inner
setup_problem_thermal_front: Front axle +{delta}°C vs rear — balance too forward
setup_problem_thermal_rear: Rear axle +{delta}°C vs front — balance too rearward
setup_problem_roll_front: Front roll ({roll_f} mm) >> rear ({roll_r} mm) — ratio {ratio}
setup_problem_roll_rear: Rear roll ({roll_r} mm) >> front ({roll_f} mm) — ratio {ratio}
setup_problem_pitch: Max brake pitch {pitch} mm — pronounced front compression
setup_problem_brake_early: {n} corners with early braking (>10 m before reference lap)
setup_problem_slow_apex: {n} corners with lower apex speed (>5 km/h slower than reference)
setup_problem_late_throttle: {n} corners with late throttle application (>10 m after reference)
setup_problem_camber_excess: Excess negative camber on {pos}: inner {grad}°C hotter than outer
setup_problem_camber_insufficient: Insufficient camber on {pos}: outer {grad}°C hotter than inner
setup_problem_brake_fade: Brake efficiency loss: {sev}% mean degradation per lap
setup_problem_roll_front_excess: Excessive front roll vs rear (ratio {ratio}): roll_f={roll_f} mm vs roll_r={roll_r} mm
setup_problem_roll_rear_excess: Excessive rear roll vs front (ratio {ratio}): roll_f={roll_f} mm vs roll_r={roll_r} mm
setup_problem_pitch_session: High longitudinal pitch: {pitch} mm front-rear difference
setup_problem_high_freq_steer: High steering frequency (FFT high={fft_h}, nervousness={nerv}): probable excessive damper rebound
setup_problem_mid_freq_steer: Elevated mid-frequency component (FFT mid={fft_m}): possible spring rate issue
setup_problem_medium_nervous: Moderate driver nervousness ({nerv}) — car lacks full driver confidence
setup_problem_low_overlap_session: Very low brake-throttle overlap: {ov}% of time (target 8–18%)
setup_problem_understeer_session: Structural understeer: {us_pct}% of corner time with understeer
setup_problem_oversteer_session: Structural oversteer: {os_pct}% of time with oversteer
setup_rc_camber_insufficient: Insufficient negative camber — the inner shoulder is working too hard
setup_rc_camber_excess: Excess negative camber — the outer shoulder is overloaded
setup_rc_overheat: Excessive thermal load: low pressure, high lateral load, or unsuitable compound
setup_rc_cold: Tyre not activated: high pressure, insufficient load, or compound too hard
setup_rc_thermal_front: The front axle works much harder: excess front downforce or stiff front ARB
setup_rc_thermal_rear: The rear axle works much harder: excess rear downforce or stiff rear ARB
setup_rc_asymmetry: Normal in circuits with corner imbalance. If excessive, may indicate pressure differences.
setup_rc_fade: Brakes heat up progressively and lose bite — inadequate compound or cooling
setup_rc_fade_zones: In those zones the driver brakes equally but the car does not respond equally — risk of overshooting braking point
setup_rc_roll_front: Front ARB too soft or rear too stiff → excessive lateral load on front axle → understeer
setup_rc_roll_rear: Rear ARB too soft or front too stiff → low-speed mechanical oversteer
setup_rc_bottoming: Suspension reaches mechanical limit — insufficient ride height or springs too soft in those zones
setup_rc_pitch: Front springs or compression dampers too soft for braking load
setup_rc_understeer: Very front-biased aero balance or lack of rear downforce relative to front
setup_rc_oversteer: Excess rear downforce or lack of front load — rear very light by comparison
setup_rc_mild_understeer: The car rotates, but the front axle works slightly harder than the rear
setup_rc_nervous_high_freq: Rear rebound dampers too stiff — the car bounces and loses contact
setup_rc_nervous_mid_freq: Springs too stiff for the circuit profile — the car skips over bumps
setup_rc_nervous_general: The car is unpredictable at the limit — could be aero or mechanical balance
setup_rc_low_overlap: The driver fully releases the brake before opening throttle — possible entry understeer
setup_rc_brake_early: The driver does not trust the braking limit — possible lack of front grip feel or fade
setup_rc_slow_apex: Low apex speed — could be car balance (understeer forces speed reduction) or technique
setup_rc_late_throttle: The driver does not trust exit traction — possible power oversteer or car balance
setup_rc_inconsistent: The driver does not repeat the same reference in those corners — could be nervous car or lack of clear visual reference point.
setup_rc_degradation_high: The car loses time linearly throughout the stint. A high R² indicates constant mechanical cause (tyres out of thermal window or cumulative fade) rather than isolated driving errors.
setup_rc_degradation_moderate: Pace drops gradually — tyres losing grip or temperature out of optimal range during the stint.
setup_rc_understeer_session: The front axle loses grip before the rear systematically — aero or mechanical balance is biased toward the front.
setup_rc_oversteer_session: The rear axle loses grip before the front — aero balance too rearward or not enough front downforce.
setup_rc_mild_understeer_session: The nose works slightly harder than the rear — fine-tuning can improve rotation.
setup_rc_temp_overheat: Mean temperature of {t}°C exceeds the optimal limit by {delta}°C. Accelerated degradation and grip loss.
setup_rc_temp_cold: Temperature too low — compound does not activate properly. The car loses grip especially in the first corners of the stint.
setup_rc_camber_excess_rc: Too much negative camber — the inner shoulder works excessively, overheating and degrading before the outer.
setup_rc_camber_insufficient_rc: Very positive or neutral camber — the outer shoulder carries all the load in corners.
setup_rc_brake_temp: Brake discs working above optimal range — risk of thermal fade and accelerated pad wear.
setup_rc_front_hotter: Front-rear thermal imbalance — the front axle is overloaded. Indicates aero or mechanical understeer: the nose pushes before the rear loads.
setup_rc_rear_hotter: Rear axle overloaded — possible power oversteer or rear aero balance.
setup_rc_lateral_asymmetry: Significant left-right asymmetry — could be a circuit with predominantly one-direction corners, or different camber/pressure between sides.
setup_rc_brake_fade: Pedal pressure does not translate to proportional deceleration — brakes lose effectiveness throughout the stint due to disc and pad overheating.
setup_rc_brake_fade_light: Mild fade present — brakes are working near the thermal limit.
setup_rc_bottoming_session: The chassis contacts the ground in certain circuit zones — the car momentarily loses suspension geometry control and may damage the floor.
setup_rc_roll_front_session: The front anti-roll bar is too soft — the front axle rolls more than the rear in corners, generating progressive understeer.
setup_rc_roll_rear_session: The rear anti-roll bar is too soft — the rear axle rolls more than the front, generating power-on oversteer and nervousness.
setup_rc_pitch_session: The nose dives excessively under braking — front springs or dampers too soft for braking load. The car changes geometry on every brake application.
setup_rc_high_freq_steer: The tyre does not regain contact quickly after bumps — the damper is too stiff in rebound, causing it to skip.
setup_rc_mid_freq_steer: The car oscillates at mid-frequency — the suspension natural frequency is close to the circuit's excitation frequency (repeated soft bounces).
setup_rc_medium_nervous: The driver makes frequent micro-corrections without reaching a critical level. Could be slightly unstable setup or technical circuit.
setup_rc_low_overlap_session: The driver does not use brake-throttle overlap in transitions — may lose entry rotation by releasing the brake too early.
setup_rec_camber_add: Add −0.3° to −0.5° of camber on the {axle} axle
setup_rec_camber_reduce: Reduce camber on {axle} axle +0.3° to +0.5° (less negative)
setup_rec_pressure_raise: Increase pressure {pos} +0.1–0.15 bar. If it persists, evaluate harder compound.
setup_rec_pressure_lower: Reduce pressure {pos} −0.1 bar. Check toe and camber. Consider softer compound.
setup_rec_thermal_front: Reduce front wing 1–2 clicks or increase rear wing. Alternatively soften front ARB.
setup_rec_thermal_rear: Increase front wing or reduce rear wing. Soften rear ARB.
setup_rec_asymmetry: Asymmetric adjustment: reduce pressure on {side} side −0.05 bar. Verify both sides start from the same cold pressure.
setup_rec_fade: Increase brake duct size. If degradation exceeds 30%, switch to a more heat-resistant compound.
setup_rec_fade_zones: Check disc temperature in those zones. Consider pads with higher operating temperature (>700°C).
setup_rec_arb_front: Stiffen front ARB 1–2 clicks or soften rear ARB 1 click. Also evaluate increasing front spring rate.
setup_rec_arb_rear: Stiffen rear ARB 1–2 clicks or soften front ARB 1 click.
setup_rec_ride_height: Raise ride height 2–5 mm. If bottoming occurs under braking, stiffen front springs.
setup_rec_pitch: Increase front spring rate 5–10 Nm/mm or stiffen front compression damping 2 clicks.
setup_rec_understeer: Increase rear wing angle (more rear load). Check front splitter position. If no aero adjustment: increase rear toe-in or reduce front ARB.
setup_rec_oversteer: Increase front downforce (more splitter angle or front wing). Reduce rear wing or rear toe-in. Mechanical alternative: stiffer front ARB.
setup_rec_mild_understeer: Fine adjustment: reduce front tyre pressure −0.05 bar or soften front ARB 1 click.
setup_rec_damper_rebound: Soften rear rebound 2–3 clicks. Check damper gas pressure.
setup_rec_springs: Reduce rear spring stiffness 5 Nm/mm or check bump stops.
setup_rec_mechanical: Check tyre pressures. Verify geometry (toe/camber). Reduce rear ARB stiffness 1 click as a starting point.
setup_rec_trail_braking: Practice trail braking: maintain light brake pressure up to the apex. May also indicate car balance requires earlier brake release.
setup_rec_brake_early: Work on braking point in priority corners. Verify no fade in those zones. Reduce brake pressure progressively to find the real limit.
setup_rec_slow_apex: If understeer: review setup (rear wing, front ARB). If technique: work on faster entry and progressive braking.
setup_rec_late_throttle: Check rear toe-in (more toe-in = greater exit stability). Review differential (if adjustable). Consider softening rear ARB.
setup_rec_inconsistent: Set a visual marker for the braking point in each inconsistent corner. If the car is the cause: check dampers (excessive rebound generates unpredictable bouncing) and verify suspension does not bottom in those zones.
setup_rec_degradation_high: Check start-of-stint pressures (reduce −0.05 bar if overheating). Review camber — an excessively hot outer shoulder indicates insufficient camber. On long stints: plan active brake management in the final laps.
setup_rec_degradation_moderate: Review initial pressures and entry temperature. Evaluate if warm-up is sufficient before setting serious lap times.
setup_rec_temp_overheat: Reduce inflation pressure 0.05–0.10 bar on {pos}. Check camber: excess negative camber overheats the inner shoulder. On high-downforce circuits: review wing configuration.
setup_rec_temp_cold: Increase inflation pressure 0.05 bar on {pos}. Evaluate warm-up procedure — more active warm-up laps. If problem persists: reduce negative camber to make the tyre work more.
setup_rec_camber_excess: Reduce camber on {pos} by 0.3–0.5°. Check temperature with pyrometer after session (inner/mid/outer). Target: inner-outer gradient < 10°C.
setup_rec_camber_insufficient: Increase negative camber on {pos} by 0.3–0.5°. The tyre should work mainly with the center-outer shoulder.
setup_rec_brake_temp: Increase brake duct opening on {pos}. If no duct adjustment: check air duct is not obstructed. Reduce brake bias toward that axle if temperature is asymmetric.
setup_rec_front_hotter: Review brake bias pressure. If understeer: increase rear downforce or reduce front downforce. Verify static weight distribution is correct.
setup_rec_rear_hotter: Check rear tyre pressures. Reduce rear downforce or increase front. Review differential (if adjustable): low opening on exit loads the rear.
setup_rec_lateral_asymmetry: Check left vs right inflation pressure. Adjust camber asymmetrically if the circuit justifies it. On clockwise circuits: normal, but verify it does not exceed 15°C.
setup_rec_brake_fade: Increase brake duct opening. Check pad compound (harder pad if thermal fade). Review brake radiators if the car has them. On long races: adjust brake bias toward the end of the stint (compensate differential fade).
setup_rec_brake_fade_light: Monitor disc temperature. If ducts exist, increase opening 1 position. Review braking technique: late entry lines increase load.
setup_rec_bottoming_session: Raise front or rear ride height according to bottoming pattern. If only one corner: increase spring stiffness on that corner by 5–10 Nm/mm. Check damper rebound (excessive rebound can encourage bottoming).
setup_rec_roll_front_session: Stiffen front ARB 2–3 clicks or move up one hardness position. Verify the response does not become sudden oversteer — adjust in increments.
setup_rec_roll_rear_session: Stiffen rear ARB 2–3 clicks or move up one position. If exit oversteer: also check differential and rear toe.
setup_rec_pitch_session: Stiffen front spring 5–10 Nm/mm or increase front compression damping. Also check front bump stop — it may be used prematurely.
setup_rec_damper_rebound_session: Soften damper rebound (especially front) by 2–3 clicks. Test on circuit in bumpy zones and verify the car settles better over irregularities.
setup_rec_springs_session: Modify spring rate to change natural frequency. If visible oscillation in onboard video: change stiffness ±10 Nm/mm.
setup_rec_mechanical_session: Review general suspension setup (ARB balance, pressures). Check possible oversteer triggers in the circuit (outside wall on traction).
setup_rec_trail_braking_session: Work on trail braking technique: maintain light braking while starting the turn. This transfers weight to the front axle and improves rotation without sacrificing apex speed.
setup_rec_understeer_session: Increase rear wing angle (more rear load). Reduce front downforce (splitter or front wing). If no aero adjustment available: soften front ARB 2 clicks or increase rear toe-in. Also check that front tyre pressures are not excessive.
setup_rec_oversteer_session: Increase front downforce (front wing or splitter). Reduce rear wing angle if there is excess rear load. Increase front ARB or reduce rear ARB. Check rear toe-in: more toe-in increases stability.
setup_rec_mild_understeer_session: Reduce front tyre pressure −0.05 bar. Soften front ARB 1 click. If car has adjustable front toe-in: reduce slightly.
setup_detail_overheat: Overtemperature accelerates degradation and reduces grip in the final laps.
setup_detail_cold: Tyre not activated, out of working window.

setup_detail_arb_rear: Roll ratio F/R: {ratio} — target >0.80 for neutral balance.
